name: paperclip-adapter-hermes-control
description: Hermes Control adapter for Paperclip: the agent runs only in the Hermes profile explicitly assigned to it (assignments table shared with the plugin), launched with the administered Hermes binary and a controlled environment; configuration refusals are not retried; Provider and Model menus list what Hermes knows; skills assigned in Paperclip are linked into that profile's skills folder. Drop-in override of the built-in hermes_local adapter.
author: Cyril M

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
